subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface reactions, edits, read receipts, typing, and presence through the existing inbound/system-event primitives, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook or adapter contract?
rationale: The current code has partial primitives, but choosing the public SDK shape affects third-party compatibility and overlaps with an open inbound_activity hook proposal plus bundled Discord lifecycle work.

options.title: Document Current Primitives First
options.body: Treat non-message activity as routed system or inbound events, document the exact plugin recipe and context requirements, and add code only where the recipe proves insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Event Hook
options.body: Define a versioned Plugin SDK event hook or adapter and align it with the open inbound_activity and Discord edit/delete work before implementation lands.

options.title: Ask For A Minimal Plugin Sketch
options.body: Have the Zoho Cliq plugin author provide a reduced external plugin example showing why runtime.channel.inbound.run and system events cannot satisfy the use case.

recommendation.title: Document Current Primitives First
recommendation.body: Treat non-message activity as routed system or inbound events, document the exact plugin recipe and context requirements, and add code only where the recipe proves insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current routing candidate for the compatibility-sensitive SDK direction because he merged the current central SDK/channel surface and appears in the related provenance.
